body:
Keep third-party dependencies in a contrib module; register the module in go.work and Taskfile MODULES. Build and test that module explicitly as part of the multi-module gate. A root go test ./... does not walk nested module boundaries, so an unregistered module can otherwise look untested but green.

Evidence: ds:block?id=workspace-f7vpgvxp; ds:block?id=gate-9g2wphfm; ds:block?id=core-boundaries-y4kpz7kr. See docs/architecture.md and docs/operating-notes.md. Verified from the implementation and tests on 2026-11-01; server-test gates are explicitly distinguished from execution.
title: Add a module to both workspace and gates
